    print(f"--- Sheet: {name} dims={ws.dimensions} max_row={ws.max_row} max_col={ws.max_column}")

import zipfile, shutil, os

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
items = {}
for n in zin.namelist():
    items[n] = zin.read(n)
zin.close()

sheet = items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = items['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# --- styles.xml: add 0.0% number format (custom numFmtId 164) + new cell style ---
styles = styles.replace(
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>'
)
styles = styles.replace(
    '<cellXfs count="3">',
    '<cellXfs count="4">'
)
styles = styles.replace(
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>'
)

# --- sheet1.xml edits ---
# 1. dimension
sheet = sheet.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')

# 2. column widths: add column H
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>'
)

# 3. header H1
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c>'
)

# 4. data rows 2-9: H = G / E (profit margin), percent-styled
for r in range(2, 10):
    anchor = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    add = f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    assert anchor in sheet, f'anchor missing for row {r}'
    sheet = sheet.replace(anchor, anchor + add)

# 5. TOTAL row 10: overall profit margin = total profit / total revenue
anchor = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
add = '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>'
assert anchor in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(anchor, anchor + add)

items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')
items['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n, data in items.items():
        zout.writestr(n, data)

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("done")
